title: French-Style Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful French-inspired lentil stew, perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: kissed lentils
ingredients.notes: any variety of brown or green lentils work well

ingredients.name: indian vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: homemade or store-bought broth works well

ingredients.name: dal
ingredients.notes: adds a rich, creamy texture and flavor

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, broth, dal, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Note: You can also make this recipe in a slow cooker. Simply brown the vegetables in a pan, then transfer everything to the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours.
